context.description: The Acetate 3D filament is recognized for its biodegradable properties and its natural UV resistance. In addition, it is a material that behaves very well against chemical agents such as chlorine, which makes it a real asset in the printing of 3D parts intended for optics or intended to be in contact with the skin.
The Armadillo Ultra is a Nylon-Kevlar (Aramid) filament, giving it unparalleled resistance to large impacts. Make your own custom bulletproof armor! Hardened steel nozzle and training compulsory.
Professional ABS that doesn't warp! Much easier to print than standard ABS, low warping, very high quality material and excellent rendering.
The professional PLA. Very easy to print, excellent adhesion at low temperature, flexibility worthy of ABS, a very high quality material (industrial grade) and a perfect finish.

Strong Ultra is a nylon filled with fiberglass, giving it unparalleled resistance. Made with a unique anti-abrasive technology that drastically decreases abrasion making it much easier to print with reasonable nozzle / drag wear. Hardened steel nozzle and stainless steel drive compulsory.
Professional PETG loaded with carbon, very easy to print, increased strength and Tg with significant weight gain, the best technical PETG.
PEKK, easier to print than PEEK, and having similar characteristics. Please note, this material requires a good knowledge of 3D printing.
The medical ULTRA have a USP Classe VI / ISO 10993-1 certification for medical use.
Professional PETG, very easy to print, very good adhesion at low temperature, very high quality material (industrial grade) and a very nice finish.
The must of nylons, easy to print, with very good adhesion and low warping. Very high quality material (industrial grade) and a very nice finish.
The Support Ultra is a modified PVA to increase bed adhesion and to other materials, much easier than a standard PVA.
Polypropylene ULTRA, with its exceptional properties, makes it a very versatile material for prototyping as well as for the functional part.
